Notes:
 1. Unless modified by Section 2 of this PUD, the land use definitions in UDC §1.4 apply.
 2. Nothing in this PUD shall prohibit alcohol sales in any non-residential district (including retail sales and golf course
    beverage cart sales), subject to any applicable conditions outside the scope of this PUD.
 3. See individual Land Use Category Standards and Table 6 for the various types of SFD residential lots and minimum lot
    sizes allowed in each category.
 4. Screening for Personal Recreational Vehicle Storage is required.
 5. Where applicable, the maximum percentage allowed is defined to be the floor area of all non-residential uses divided by
    the gross area of the parcels.
